title: Area∩upgrade exact-name collision scan (role-title renames, upgrade only)
scope: Exact string match: region.areas[] entry === region.upgrades[].name inside the same region.
Proposals rename the upgrade only (role title). Area strings stay as map/place pins.
content[] collisions are out of scope for this file (none found on current catalog).
Do not edit data/research/catalog.json in this pass — scan + proposals only.
policy: areas[] keep canonical place names (map anchors / league area list).
upgrades[] must not reuse a bare place name when that string is also an area — use a role title that names the unlock/stack.
Prefer established role titles from scripts/apply-region-wiki-audits.mjs where those already exist on upgrades[].
If the role title already exists (often as an identical detail twin, sometimes doubled — see issue-04 / issue-04a), apply by removing the bare place-name upgrade rather than renaming into a triple.
True rename only when no role-title twin exists (currently: asgarnia Invention Guild).
